app.subtitle: Launch several Roblox accounts at once · unofficial tool, not affiliated with Roblox
lang.label: Language
status.disclaimer: Unofficial tool – not affiliated with or endorsed by Roblox Corporation · logins stay encrypted on this PC
banner.title: Roblox is already open – close it first
banner.text: Several Roblox windows only work if AltDeck starts before Roblox. Close every Roblox window (or click the button) – multi-instance turns on by itself as soon as they're closed.
banner.failText: Another program (for example another launcher or alt manager) may be holding Roblox's lock. Close it and wait a moment – AltDeck keeps trying.
banner.confirm: Close {0} Roblox window(s) now? Unsaved progress in those games may be lost.

add.title: Add account
add.info: Your username and password are typed into the official Roblox login page in a secure window. If Roblox asks for a captcha or 2-step code, just complete it there.
add.useCookie: Advanced: add with a .ROBLOSECURITY cookie instead
login.title: Log in to Roblox
login.hint: This is the real Roblox login page. Solve the captcha or 2-step check if one appears. The window closes by itself once you're logged in.
login.noWebView:
The login window needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (normally built into Windows 10/11).

The download page will open now. Install it, then try again.

You can also add the account with a cookie instead.
api.expired: This account's login has expired. Right-click it and choose Re-login.
api.rateLimited: Roblox is rate-limiting requests. Wait a minute and try again.
api.noLogin: No saved login for this account. Right-click it and choose Re-login.
api.shareInvalid: That share link isn't a private server link, or it has expired.
